questions.question: What share of welded joints gets a dye-penetrant check under the QP-07 inspection of the B-220 and L-410 batch received 12 October 2026?
questions.answer: A dye-penetrant check is done on 10% of the welded joints.

questions.question: In the acceptance criteria for the B-220 mixing bowls and L-410 ladles, what grade applies to a scratch longer than 15 mm on a food-contact surface?
questions.answer: Surface scratches longer than 15 mm on a food-contact surface are classed as grade B.

questions.question: How far from the seam weld is the deepest rim dent on the worst SKU B-220 bowl in the inspection findings?
questions.answer: The deepest point of the 2.1 mm dent sits 35 mm from the seam weld.

questions.question: How long was the hairline crack found at the handle-to-bowl weld on ladle SKU L-410 during dye-penetrant testing?
questions.answer: The hairline crack on the L-410 ladle weld was 11 mm long, oriented across the weld toe, and was rejected under clause 2.

questions.question: In the QC inspection report's disposition section, how many days does the supplier have to submit a corrective action report on the handle weld?
questions.answer: The supplier must provide a corrective action report on the handle weld within 15 days, as the batch is accepted conditionally.

questions.question: In the defect register for batch QC-2026-114, what size was the rim deformation recorded on SKU B-220 unit 088?
questions.answer: The rim deformation on unit 088 (B-220) measured 0.8 mm, graded A and accepted.

questions.question: In the batch QC-2026-114 defect register, what disposition was given to the L-410 unit 067 with weld porosity at the weld root?
questions.answer: Unit 067 (SKU L-410) with two pores of weld porosity at the weld root was graded Reject and scrapped.

questions.question: In batch QC-2026-114, what was the disposition of the L-410 unit with a hairline crack at the handle-to-bowl weld toe?
questions.answer: The L-410 unit 022, with an 11 mm hairline crack at the handle-to-bowl weld toe, was graded Reject and scrapped.

questions.question: In batch QC-2026-114, what was the defect type, location and size on the L-410 unit 022, and how was it dispositioned?
questions.answer: Unit 022 (L-410) had an 11 mm hairline crack at the handle-to-bowl weld toe, graded Reject and scrapped.

questions.question: In the QC inspection of mixing bowl SKU B-220 unit 117, how far from the seam weld is the rim dent located?
questions.answer: The rim dent sits 35 mm from the seam weld.

questions.question: What length was the hairline crack found at the weld toe on serving ladle SKU L-410, unit 22, after dye-penetrant testing, and what was the disposition?
questions.answer: The hairline crack at the weld toe measured 11 mm and the ladle was marked REJECT.
